title: PACEvolve: Enabling Long-Horizon Progress-Aware Consistent Evolution
venue: ICLR Workshop on Lifelong Agents: Learning, Aligning, Evolving

publication.venue: ICLR Workshop on Lifelong Agents: Learning, Aligning, Evolving

mechanism.domainTask: Long-horizon LLM-guided scientific and engineering optimization, including symbolic regression and GPU kernels
mechanism.populationDetail: PACEvolve-Single runs one trajectory/context pool, while PACEvolve-Multi uses two islands with separate search states; each context also has a hierarchical idea-to-hypothesis memory.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No distinct candidate elite archive is clearly specified; HCM stores ideas, hypotheses, and histories as context memory rather than a conventional elite archive.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Evaluated hypotheses are appended to idea histories. At configured caps, histories are summarized and low-promise ideas are pruned, with failures retained in a separate global log; this is context management rather than conventional survivor replacement.
mechanism.generationDetail: Selected ideas guide broad candidate refinement from an existing solution; in multi-island CE, crossover combines components from two parent solutions, often from different islands. Backtracking restores an earlier trajectory state.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Task score/metrics drive progress tracking and idea selection; summarized histories provide LLM-readable context. Exact boundary between evaluator output and post-evaluation LLM summary is not fully specified.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Backtracking selects one ancestral search state; crossover combines two island solutions. These mechanisms have different cardinalities and are chosen adaptively after stagnation.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Hierarchical conceptual-idea and experimental-hypothesis memory with LLM classification, summarization, pruning, and persistent failure logging is a context-management structure not captured by conventional candidate population/archive fields.

provenance.citationWarning: Current evaluation feedback and parent-selection citations are supported. Distinguish PACEvolve-Single from PACEvolve-Multi: cross-island CE/crossover applies only to multi-island mode. Do not infer a PACEvolve Flash model from the generic secondary-model statement; Gemini 2.5 Pro is the confirmed base model.
